replies.author: Myv
replies.body:
• It's small
  • There is a lot of void but that doesn't matter so much in a DTM
  • The block palette is basic, has no variety but doesn't look bad.
  • Spawn is fine, but the map needs more islands and to be longer in my opinion, with more accessible paths to the mid for example.
  • Do what ^ said with the screenshots and also use FOV 90.
It's an okay start but could do with improvements, am looking forward to see it improved if you take on board our feedback.

* People dont like too detailed maps
*It is not fun playing detailed maps as they end Early
*This map is so fun to play as I tested this XML in my own server.
*Avicus is dieing because of detailed maps.
See this image
https://i.ytimg.com/vi/rR_mDWKpTUY/maxresdefault.jpg
Now people enjoy maps which are easy to rush and dont end early.
thats why Avic is dieing and People enjoy playing to CraftRealms.
I am writing above consequences with my own 5 years experience.

replies.author: Riilo
replies.body:
{tag=f75f02022e174675bd52ccb5976b4f61}
Okay, first of all, you were given feedback. If more than one person is saying the same thing, then they're most likely right. You're stating Avicus is dying because of detailed maps? This isn't true at all. You have to learn how to accept feedback, or your map probably won't get accepted. 

For my own personal opinion, the map is quite small. It's definitely a start. There needs to be some more islands with detail, and maybe some changes of the shapes of the islands.

Also, please take more images, in normal FOV (70). If you would like me to help msg me on discord (Rilo#5735)

replies.author: KomodoLord1
replies.body:
-1
I completely agree with what Rilo said. People actually DO like detailed maps as they can be aesthetically pleasing and cool to play on. If you were to take more time you can make a map with good detail but also a good in-play time.
The reasons I personally don't like your map for:
1. The map is small 2. It is a basic design that anyone can build, add a new twist which players haven't seen before to make your map more unique. 3. Colour palette is small and bland 4. The map is too flat  5. Too quick to run from spawn to middle/monument to defend, so make the map BIGGER 6. There is a large void gap between spawn island and middle 7. The middle is too thin so widen that to fill void gap 7.  Don't try and interlock stone brick and quartz/snow (it doesn't work)
Overall: Try again completely and think of something inventive or maybe try collaborating with someone to help you build
